assertions.title: High Concurrency Load Handling - 20 concurrent evaluations
assertions.criteria: 20 concurrent evaluations created within 1 second, all accepted (202), 20 K8s Jobs created, all complete successfully

steps.observed: BLOCKED - No Jobs created to monitor

apiResponses: Time to create all 20: ~0.14 seconds (< 1 second requirement)
evidence.kubectlOutput: No resources found in llm-eval namespace
evidence.databaseQuery: 71 total evaluations (50 prior + 21 new including one test run)

assertions.issues: K8s Jobs are not being created for evaluations. The API accepts requests and creates DB records, but no Kubernetes Jobs are spawned in the llm-eval namespace. This suggests either: (1) the Job creation logic is not triggered, (2) the K8s client is not properly configured, or (3) there's an async worker that hasn't processed the evaluations.

frictions.description: All evaluations stuck in 'pending' status - K8s Jobs not being created despite K8s namespace existing
frictions.resolution: Investigated but could not resolve - Jobs not appearing even after 20+ evaluations created

blockers.description: No K8s Jobs are being created for evaluations. Cannot verify '20 Jobs complete successfully' requirement because no Jobs exist to complete.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Verified llm-eval namespace exists, kubectl accessible, API healthy. Jobs still not appearing.

summary: Tested VAL-CROSS-010: 20 concurrent evaluations created and all returned HTTP 202 within 0.14 seconds (PASS for acceptance criteria). However, 0 K8s Jobs were created in the llm-eval namespace (FAIL for Job creation). Evaluations are recorded in DB with 'pending' status but never transition to 'running' or create K8s Jobs. Cannot verify Job completion because no Jobs were created.
